title: Hindola Raga
visual_inspection: Inspected using view_image: complete portrait composition with central swing, surrounding figures and instruments.
interpretive_limit: Comparative Pahari spring imagery; not evidence of Odisha Jhulana ritual, season or performance.
suggested_caption: Hindola Raga, c.1790–1800, Northern India, Pahari kingdoms. Cleveland Museum of Art, Edward L. Whittemore Fund, 1975.9, CC0. This springtime painting offers a comparison for swing imagery; it does not document Jhulana in Odisha.
